title: Hearth Cricket
text: Hearth Cricket. I bought an antique brass finished  cricket which i liked very much. This verdigris cricket is OK but just more green than vertigris. Maybe a little finish correcting would help.

features: A cricket on the hearth is considered a sign of good luck
Made of solid brass, with Polished finish
Also available in rustic Verdi finish
Minuteman International makes a full line of wood stove, fireplace and hearth accessories, including Fireplace Screens, Tool Sets, Log Holders and Hearth Rugs
description: Crickets have been long revered for their beautiful song and many cultures have observed their habits as a natural indicators of the season. A symbol of knowledge and prosperity, to have one in the house is considered good luck. These Hearth Crickets will bring that good fortune to your home. Available in polished Brass or Verdi finish.
